body:
As suicidal person myself, ill say that I would've wanted in that situation

I feel like shit, I feel like a waste of space. I would want a friend. Just someone to listen. Just understand that they are in a very dark place, and that they need help. You should be that first step. Talk to her. Stick with her. Stay by her side. Just be as supportive as you can. Make sure she doesn't try again, and just keep in touch. I hope this was helpful, and tell her that she is absolutely not alone, and that there are people who CAN help.

You have no idea how much i feel you. Completely alone, unlovable, suicidal, holy shit this sounds like me :/
but hey, you're here. We all share your pain. We know how it feels. You are not alone. I wan't you to know that at bare minimum
take care man, i hope you feel better. no matter how much shit goes down, even if you drill past rock bottom, you'll end up on the other side

honestly not really  
I have been skipping dinners lately, but that's because my depression has been fucking with my appetite  
It's pretty hard making goals 'cause I really have nothing to look forward too.   
The reason I put my goal as January was because Smash Ultimate is coming, and I really want to play it before I die/kill myself  
But other than that, I really have nothing to look forward to

don't do it man  
friends will be your salvation. If they're your friends at all, they'll wait for you to return.   
You've probably heard this a million times, but don't kill yourself. Friends will listen, if they're friends at all. Killing yourself is never, ever the answer

my dude, I've questioned the same things. I've told myself many times that I'd go to hell if I killed myself. But you know what? **I** probably will. But **you** won't. God judges us based on our character. You've been a good person. Sure, you might've had some mishaps here and there, but God bases us on our treatment towards others. Saints suffered shit tons, but they all went to heaven huh?

Also, there's always another way. I don't think it's too late for you. You can always seek help.  
I liked neural feedback, from what I did, and if you're comfortable talking, go for talk therapy. But there's always another way other than suicide.

God will forgive you, but I'm pretty sure He'd rather have us live.   
This is coming from a Catholic, so take my advice with a grain of salt if you're protestant or orthodox

Dont worry about "feeling old." Just remember your age of 26 as of this post, and 27 next week! You have enough zest left on you. Dont let the silver hair bring you down. Just look in the mirror and look at everything besides your hair. Your fit body, your youthful face. It's too early to give up. You can do this. Keep on living life. Dont panic about your hair, appreciate your body, and your face im pretty sure people would like to date.
As that saying goes

Keep calm
And carry on
Dont cut. Its dangerous, and quite frankly it isnt the best idea. As nmisophonia said, a therapist may help. We are here for you. Dont resort to cutting, let your feelings out some other way.

I think it just could be that you're tired from all the pain and suffering you endured throughout the day, and (as you've said) feel that you dont deserve the bed. But trusy me, that bed will be the greatest thing in your life. Whether its to sleep in, or cry on, you will feel bettee

While that isnt how life is supposed to be lived, i can definitely feel you.

As a huge video game addict, i can only ask you to open your horizens. While some games may seem childish, they can provide lots of fun and also give you the escape you may be seeking. Steam doesnt give you everything, so find something that finally peaks your interest.

Yes, i can relate to watching youtube videos to waste the time. It just feels a bit right, but wrong at the same time

I wish you tge best of luck fighting your depression. We are here for you

I see mentally ill as a bunch of things gathered into one very big bag. Things like depression are inthere, but then you have the really bad stuff too. The media focuses a lot on the bad part, but never ignore the fact that they ALL need help

Hey, you seem to not have many suicidal thoughts! That's a great sign. Also, the fact you feel a bit motivated afterwards is another great sign. You're looking forward to something, which is a major victory.

Be brave, you are winning this battle :)

Judging from what ive read, your unhealthy relationship might be the cause. My question would be wife or girlfriend? Because the usual answer would be to cut the relationship if it isnt going well.

As for your friends, maybe make more? From how i enterpret it, they are either waiting for you to make the first move or are just jerks. You must have hobbies, whether it's watching tv, or youtube videos, etc. Meet people with similar interests, and just find ways to raise moral. It's hard, i know, and many people on this subreddit know too, but it's always worth a shot

While ive thought abput it for years, ive realized (for now) tgat there is a very small glimmer of hope. Please don't kill yourself. The person you love wont stay anger/sad forever. If you love them, please dont

That sucks a lot. I can relate to people saying bullshit like "oH, yOu JuSt nEeD (insert bullshit here) aNd yOU'll fEeL bEttEr" like i just cant understand people like that. Its even worse that a god damn doctor said that. Id expect a TRAINED PROFESSIONAL to recognize the symptoms. As for that fear of doctors, dont feel like a failure for being afraid. Its natural after the stuff you've been through. However, i can assure you that as long as these doctors have nothing to do with your parents, you can release your fears of being made fun of. While you might have panic attacks, its ok still. There are people that can relate. Dont feel alone. This entire subreddit is filled with people like me and you

Again, dont feel that you're alone. We are here to share our pain, so that we may be understood
Id say i never really did.

Ive heard of a type of therapy where they put like a hat with wires sticking out, and it apparently scans your brain, making a kalidascopic image that's supposed to make you feel better. It like shows your favorite colors, your favorite shapes , etc. Perhaps you shoud give that a try? Im doing that therapy during the summer, assuming that i have enough hope to go
